Thanks for contributing to warden.wz.

This repository has focused pull request templates. Please use the one that best
matches your change:

- Feature:
  - Template file:
    https://github.com/sravioli/warden.wz/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/feature.md
  - Query parameter: `?template=feature.md`
- Bug fix:
  - Template file:
    https://github.com/sravioli/warden.wz/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/bug_fix.md
  - Query parameter: `?template=bug_fix.md`
- Documentation:
  - Template file:
    https://github.com/sravioli/warden.wz/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/documentation.md
  - Query parameter: `?template=documentation.md`

To use one, reopen this pull request with the matching `?template=...` value in
the URL.

If you continue with this form, please include:

### Summary

### Tests

### Compatibility
